articles.summary: Support local youth with Dutch Bros! 💛 On Friday, 9/18, $1 from every drink sold on Buck for Kids Day goes directly to local non-profits. Join the giveback!
articles.title: Dutch Bros® and the Dutch Bros Foundation® Rally Customers for 20th Annual Buck for Kids Day to Support Local Youth

articles.summary: Top off your cup this National Coffee Day! Buy any 2 Dutch Bros drinks on Sept. 29 and score a free set of limited-edition mystery straw toppers while supplies last.
articles.title: Dutch Bros® Celebrates National Coffee Day With Limited-Edition Straw Toppers

articles.summary: Get ready to glow! Starting at 6 p.m. on Tuesday, Sept. 22, get a free light-up cube with any medium or large drink at Dutch Bros, while supplies last.
articles.title: Dutch Bros® Is Giving Drinks a Glow-Up with its Latest Merch Drop
